text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The party asks around the fishing village for clues
regarding the Majimun, only to hear about sightings
of floating plushies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンの手がかりを求めて、
漁村で聞きこみをしていた{0}たち。
その最中に、村人から浮かぶぬいぐるみを目撃したという話を聞く。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
You don't think...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ、おい。
やっぱり……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
Ideally it'd just be a coincidence, but that feels like wishful thinking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん。
偶然であってほしいけど、
そうはいかない感じだね～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Did they all run off and become bad kids?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
悪い子になってしもたんやろか……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
H-hey now.
Nothing's been confirmed yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、おい姫さん。
まだそうと決まったわけじゃないだろ？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
There ain't no excuse to be stealin' people's souls.
If there's even a chance that it's true, then I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
人の魂を奪うやなんて
絶対に許されへん。
みんなが本当にそんなことをしてるなら、
うちは……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Believe in them?
text_block_list.orig_text: 信じる……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
He's right.
It doesn't matter if they're really involved or not.
If we don't believe in them, then who will?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだぜ姫さん。
いなくなったあいつらが
関係してようがしてまいが、
あたしらが信じないでどうするんだ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Well said, {0}! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ～
{0}はいいこと言うね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it'll be okay!
It's said in my homeland that benevolent spirits make their
homes in objects that've been treated well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに大丈夫さ～！
　私の故郷では、
大切にされたものには
善い魂が宿るって言われてるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
If that's really true,
then there's no way those plushies would become bad kids! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら絶対、
マホのぬいぐるみが
悪い子になるわけないよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
For sure. You talk to them and brush their hair every day.
There's no way they could do anything bad after being treated that well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよなぁ。
毎日毎日話しかけたり
ブラッシングしたり、
あれだけ大切にされてたら
悪いことなんてできるもんじゃないぜ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks, y'all.
You're right. I oughtta believe in them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
ありがとう
カオリはん。
王子はんに
マコトはんも。
そうやね。
みんなのこと、
うちが信じてあげなね。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh. We're almost at the area it was sighted.
Sheesh. Having to walk through a forest in my swimsuit isn't what I
had in mind when we talked about coming to the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
そろそろ目撃証言があった場所だぜ。
ったくよ、
海に来たってのに
水着で森に入る羽目になるとはな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This is where things went down, so there's not much else we can do!
More importantly, I wonder if there's any goya around here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
漁師さんが襲われたのがこの辺りらしいから
仕方ないさ～
それより
ゴーヤーどこかに生えてないかな～？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Much as this place might resemble your homeland, I doubt it.
Look around. It's just trees, grass and a plushie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
似てるとはいえ、
故郷そのものじゃねぇんだから
難しいだろ。
見ろよ。
あるのは木と草と
ぬいぐるみくらいだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Yup. Right over th— Wait, what?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう。
今そこに……
ってええええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no! Keep them away!
Wait, that's not the point!
I just said something weird, didn't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめろ持ってくんな気持ち悪ぃ！
　ってそうじゃねぇだろ！？
なんか今
おかしなこと言ったよなあたし！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Arthur!
text_block_list.orig_text: アーサー！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That's your plushie, for sure.
It really is floating! The heck's going here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
間違いねぇ、
姫さんのぬいぐるみだ。
おいおい、
ほんとに浮かんでやがるぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Arthur! Can you hear me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アーサー、
うちの声が聞こえる？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess! Watch out!
text_block_list.orig_text: おい気を付けろ姫さん！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
There's real bad vibes coming from that black aura
surrounding the plushie—I mean Arthur.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみ、
いやアーサーを包んでるあの黒いオーラ、
いやな感じがする……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: It might really come after our souls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最悪、
本当に魂を奪われちまうかもしれねぇぞ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: But...!
text_block_list.orig_text: でも……っ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
My prince?!
I can't believe you used your body as a shield!
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん！？
　
うちをかばって……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it's on the offensive!
Good stuff, {0}!
I'll leave the princess to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
襲ってきやがったか！
ナイスだ{0}！
そのまま姫さんを頼む！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna be tricky, though...
I don't have it in me to harm the princess's plushie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもどうすっかな……
姫さんのぬいぐるみなんて、
あたしには攻撃できねぇぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it!
text_block_list.orig_text: だ～いじょうぶさぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Kaori?!
text_block_list.orig_text: カオリはん！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 捕まえたさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Kaori! Watch out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいカオリ、
あぶねぇぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine. ♪
This is the best way to handle this situation. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫大丈夫♪
こういう時は、
こうするさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: WAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Don't raise your voice out of nowhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおぉっ！？
　いきなり大声出すなよ！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: That black aura is leaving Arthur's body...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アーサーから、
黒いものが
抜けていきはった……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Always am! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 私はいつも元気いっぱいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What the heck did you even do?
Far as I can tell, you just shouted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、何をしたんだ？
あたしには
大声を出したようにしか見えなかったけど。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's pretty much it.
text_block_list.orig_text: その通りよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
They say in my homeland that
you drop your anima when you're given a shock.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の故郷ではねぇ、
びっくりしたりすると
マブイが落ちるって言われてるんさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Anima?
That means your soul, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マブイ、って
魂のことやろか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yup!
It'll pop right out of your mouth if you sneeze, too. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう～
くしゃみしたりすると
口からすっぽ抜けたりね～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Your homeland sure sounds wild.
But man, I can't believe that solved it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恐ろしい故郷だなおい。
ってか、
それでなんとかなるのかよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Arthur!
Back to Maho you go. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいア～サ～、
マホのところにおかえりさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Arthur! Welcome back...
I can't thank you enough, Kaori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アーサー！
　おかえり……
カオリはん、
感謝しますえ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for protecting me too, my prince.
Are you okay? Still got ahold of your soul?
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんも、
庇ってくれてありがとうな。
大丈夫？
　魂は奪われてへん？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Princess! His heartbeat's got nothing to do with his soul!
You're way, way too close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい姫さん！
　心臓の音を聞いても無駄だろ！？
近い！
　近づきすぎだ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
And you should at least try and push her away a bit!
Sheesh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまえも遠慮とかしろよ！
……ったく。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
it really was possessed by something in the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
やっぱり何かが憑りついてやがったんだな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I noticed a snake-lookin' thing pop out of Arthur's body
after Kaori hollered and spooked it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリはんが
大声を出したとき、
アーサーから
蛇みたいなもんが
抜けだしていくんが見えましたなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Majimun have different forms based on different legends.
Snakes are the most common out of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンは
色々な姿形で伝わってるさ～
蛇はその中でも
代表的なものだね～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Which means everyone else has been possessed by that Majimun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
みんなは、
あの
マジムンに……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That's a pretty safe bet, given the circumstances.
Man. This ain't gonna be easy,
given just how many plushies there are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
状況的に見て、
間違いないだろうな。
参ったな、
姫さんのぬいぐるみ、
めちゃくちゃ多いよな？
あれだけの数を相手にすんのかよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
We know what've got to do now, at least. ♪
That makes the rest a lot simpler!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、目標がはっきりしたのはいいことさ～♪
あとは突き進むだけよ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye.
Kaori's right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうやね。
カオリはんの言う通りやわ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Just wait, everyone.
I'll save each and every one of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな……
待っとってね。
うちが必ず助け出すから。
